name: Friend request
purpose: Accept an optional offline suggestion and later give a saved virtual copy.
on_enter: Load existing active request or select first eligible request in deterministic catalogue order. Only offer unlocked shape requests unless Free Play.
Two pictorial preferences maximum: one colour and one shape. Matching is a suggestion, never a failure condition.
If a draft was saved with this requestId, enter ready_to_give and preview that saved creation. Otherwise offer Make or choose an existing saved toy.
on_exit: Persist active request state without deadline or loss on exit.
persistence: requestProgress keyed requestInstanceId stores catalogueId, accepted, associatedDraftId, offeredCreationId, deliveredCreationId and completion ledger key. Giving never removes the creation.
back_rule: Back02 at any time. Accept→03; save from10→12 ready_to_give; Give→thanks→02 with queued13 overlays after thanks.
acceptance: Wrong-colour toy is accepted kindly and completes the optional request.
Giving twice, reloading or skipping thanks cannot repeat metrics or reward grants.
No network messaging, actual customer queue or real recipient.
implementation_notes: An existing toy can be selected via 11 with selectionPurpose=request and returns here instead of going to play. This subflow overrides ordinary selected-card actions.
Offer colour+shape only; do not add hidden matching criteria or grade the child.
